SELECT TOP 100 * FROM DW.SuspectDuplicateReport WHERE CifId IN ('R00002402', 'R01196306') ORDER BY CifId

SELECT b.ORGKEY, b.CUST_FIRST_NAME, b.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, b.CUST_LAST_NAME, b.CORE_CUST_ID
    from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        ---left join (select accountid,bank_id,core_cust_id,state,islatest,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,cust_dob,orgkey,name,MaidenNameOfMother,GeneralTaxId FROM busc.crm_accounts WHERE islatest = 1) b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid) ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join (select * FROM busc.crm_accounts WHERE islatest = 1) b on replace(convert(varchar,a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = convert(varchar,b.accountid) ---> To connect busc.crm_accounts to get Orgkey(CifId), Name(CustomerName), Cust_DOB(DateOfBirth), MaidennameOfMother(MothersMaidenName), TIN(TaxIdentificationNumber), Cif Creation Date(CifCreationDate)
        left join (select orgkey, address_line1, address_line2, city,islatest FROM busc.crm_address WHERE islatest = 1 AND PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y') c on b.orgkey = convert(varchar,c.orgkey)      ---> Connection to get ADDRESS1 & ADDRESS2 (AddressLine1AndAddressLine2)
        left join (select value,categorytype,description,islatest FROM busc.crm_categories WHERE islatest = 1) d on d.value = c.City and d.categorytype = 'City' ---> Lookup to get the CITY (CityAndProvince)
        left join (select description, value, categorytype,islatest FROM busc.crm_categories WHERE islatest = 1) e on b.state = e.value and e.categorytype = 'State' ---> Lookup to get the STATE (CityAndProvince)
        left join (select cust_id,acid,islatest FROM busc.dep_accountrelationship WHERE DEL_FLG = 'N' AND islatest = 1 ) z on z.cust_id = b.core_cust_id --> Connection to busc.dep_accountrelationship table
        left join (select acid,foracid,SCHM_TYPE,SOL_ID,ACCT_OPN_DATE,ACCT_CLS_FLG,islatest,ACCT_CLS_DATE FROM busc.dep_generalaccountmaster WHERE islatest = 1) x on x.acid = z.acid  --> Connection to busc.dep_generalaccountmaster to get busc.dep_gam foracid(AccountNumber),  SCHM_TYPE (AccountType), SOL_ID(AccountSolId)
        left join (select acid,ACCT_STATUS,islatest FROM busc.dep_casamaster WHERE islatest = 1) y on y.acid = x.acid --> Connection for AccountStatus
        left join (select acid,ACCT_STATUS,islatest FROM busc.dep_tdmaster WHERE islatest = 1) t on t.acid = x.acid  --> Connection for AccountStatus
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT CUST_ID FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION WHERE isLatest = 1) RIB on b.ORGKEY = RIB.CUST_ID
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT CIF_NO FROM BUSC.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB WHERE isLatest = 1) MBK on b.ORGKEY = MBK.CIF_NO
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT CLT_CIF_NUMBER FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT WHERE isLatest = 1) ATM on b.ORGKEY = ATM.CLT_CIF_NUMBER
        where accountid_cust_nbr LIKE 'CBC_CRM%' AND b.ORGKEY LIKE 'R%'--- AND x.foracid IS NOT NULL

SELECT * FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE IN (1290, 403, 330, 1680)

WITH test AS (
SELECT
   [Group],
    BASE_SCORE as BaseScore,
   convert(varchar,g.cltcode) as CifId,
   ---concat(g.FNAME, ' ', g.LNAME) as CustomerName,
   CASE WHEN FNAME != ' ' THEN CONCAT(FNAME, ' ', MNAME, ' ', LNAME)
        ELSE CNAME END as CustomerName,
   convert(varchar(20),g.BDATE,101) as DateOfBirth,
   g.mother as MothersMaidenName,
   g.tin as TaxIdentificationNumber,
   g.Home_addr1 as AddressLine1AndAddressLine2,
   concat(HOME_ADDR2, ' ', HOME_ADDR3) as CityAndProvince,
   convert(varchar(20),g.DAte_created,101) as CifCreationDate,
   i.ACCTCODE as AccountNumber,
   'Securities' as AccountType,
   null as AccountSolId,
   i.STATUS as AccountStatus,
   convert(varchar(20),i.DATE_OPEN,101) as AccountOpeningDate,
   NULL as OnlineBankingIndicator,
   NULL as MobileBankingIndicator,
   NULL as LinkedCardIndicator
   from syn.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults a
        left join (select cltcode,CLTTYPE, HOME_ADDR2,HOME_ADDR3,FNAME,MNAME,LNAME,CNAME,BDATE,mother,tin,Home_addr1,DAte_created,islatest FROM busc.sec_tblclient WHERE islatest = 1) g on convert(varchar,REPLACE(SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 39, 5),'_','')) = convert(varchar,g.cltcode)    
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCTKEY, CLTCODE FROM BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK WHERE isLatest = 1) h ON g.CLTCODE = h.CLTCODE 
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCTCODE, STATUS, DATE_OPEN FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS) i ON h.ACCTKEY = i.ACCTCODE
   WHERE a.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE ('CBSec_%') AND CLTTYPE = 'I'--- AND G.cltcode = '6600'
   )
SELECT * FROM test WHERE CustomerName IS NULL
---SELECT * FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE IN (SELECT TOP 20 CifId FROM test WHERE CustomerName LIKE ' %') AND CNAME = ' '
